definitions.explanation: a time of year when business or activity is at its highest level

examples.japanese: {今|いま}は{繁忙期|はんぼうき}で{休|やす}めない。
examples.english: I can't take time off during the busy season.

examples.japanese: {繁忙期|はんぼうき}は{料金|りょうきん}が{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: Prices go up during peak season.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}{年始|ねんし}は{物流|ぶつりゅう}{業界|ぎょうかい}の{繁忙期|はんぼうき}だ。
examples.english: The year-end and New Year period is the busy season for the logistics industry.

notes:
{繁忙期|はんぼうき} refers to a time of year when business or activity is at its highest level. It is a standard business and travel term.

FORMS:
{繁忙|はんぼう} (busy, hectic) + {期|き} (period).

SIMILAR WORDS:
{閑散期|かんさんき} (slow season, off-peak period).
- ハイシーズン: high season (loanword, mainly for tourism)
- ピーク: peak (general loanword)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}に{入|はい}る: to enter the busy season
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}を{迎|むか}える: to face the busy season
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}{料金|りょうきん}: peak-season pricing

INDUSTRY EXAMPLES:
- {小売|こうり}: {年末|ねんまつ}{商戦|しょうせん} (year-end sales), お{盆|ぼん}
- {旅行|りょこう}: {夏休|なつやす}み, {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}
- {引越|ひっこ}し: 3{月|がつ}～4{月|がつ} (moving season in Japan)
